answer: Sequential work registry with irreversible time. Each new identity must complete a fixed sequence of timed physical tasks before participating; the timing is calibrated so a single person cannot parallelize them, and completion leaves an unforgeable quill-marked log. The attacker's cost is wall-clock hours per identity, not money, and each task consumes a pigment batch that cannot be reused across identities. A crystal oscillator timestamps each step, so forging the log requires defeating the timing chain itself.
